findings.text: Item 2 (B-MG-116): the floor is sampled too late. In-memory ui-t18-catchup harness: load empty conversations 4/5, add messages 1..31 to 5 during the gap, deliver SSE message 31 while 4 catches up. Output: count=30, first=2, /5/messages?after=31; message 1 is skipped. A refresh during the gap or failed page followed by reconnect also skips it. Preserve the pre-break floor until catch-up succeeds and add these regressions; that in-memory change passed all three.
